summary: Polyphony Digital's PlayStation 2 motorcycle simulation built on Gran Turismo 4 technology, with a large bike roster, license challenges, photo features, and regional extras.

entries.title: Tourist Trophy

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 or original PlayStation 2 hardware; the game supports 1080i output on PS2.

primary.why: Tourist Trophy is a PlayStation 2-only Polyphony Digital motorcycle sim and one of the few PS2 games capable of 1080i output. The North American release adds seven motorcycles, new riding gear, seven bonus music tracks, enhanced visual effects, bike profiles, and an exclusive Semi-Pro mode, making it the most complete sourced regional route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the North American PlayStation 2 release on original hardware or PCSX2 with 1080i/internal-resolution upscaling where compatible.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced sequel or remaster has materialized; possible sequel comments from Kazunori Yamauchi remain unrealized.
